title: Molecular Dynamics simulation of TDP-43 RRM in the presence and absence of RNA
authors: Scott DD; Mowrey D; Nagarajan K; François-Moutal L; Nair A; Khanna M
one_liner_zh: 该文用分子动力学模拟研究TDP-43 RRM结构域在有无RNA时的构象变化，并对比AlphaFold2预测，属于蛋白质-RNA互作的结构动态研究，虽非典型TF-DNA体系，但方法可迁移至TF-DNA互作建模。
abstract: Structural characterization of the prion prone TAR DNA Binding protein (TDP)-43 has been challenging since its intrinsically disordered regions represents 15-30% of the total protein. TDP-43 is a nucleic acid binding protein with an N-terminal domain, two RNA Recognition Motifs (RRM1 and RRM2) and the C-terminal domain. In this study, we seek to define possible new targetable sites on the apo structure of TDP-43 RRM domains. To do so, we used molecular dynamic (MD) simulations on the NMR solved TDP-43 RRM1-2 structure bound to RNA to predict the apo structure. Contact analysis of TDP-43 showed that while the integrity of the individual domains was maintained upon RNA removal, a decrease in interdomain contacts was observed. Moreover, we compared apo TDP-43 structures obtained from MD to AlphaFold 2 (AF2) predicted TDP-43 structures and found differences in loop regions. A Sitemap analysis identified five druggable sites for the RNA bound structure solved by NMR, while fewer sites were identified following MD simulations and AF2 predicted apo structures.
abstract_zh: 易患朊病毒的TAR DNA结合蛋白（TDP-43）的结构表征一直具有挑战性，因为其 intrinsically disordered regions（内在无序区域）占全蛋白的15-30%。TDP-43是一种核酸结合蛋白，包含N端结构域、两个RNA识别基序（RRM1和RRM2）以及C端结构域。在本研究中，我们旨在确定TDP-43 RRM结构域apo形式上的潜在新靶向位点。为此，我们利用分子动力学（molecular dynamics, MD）模拟，基于NMR解析的TDP-43 RRM1-2与RNA结合的结构，预测其apo结构。接触分析显示，在去除RNA后，虽然各结构域的完整性得以保持，但结构域间接触减少。此外，我们将MD模拟获得的apo TDP-43结构与AlphaFold 2（AF2）预测的TDP-43结构进行比较，发现环区存在差异。Sitemap分析识别出NMR解析的RNA结合结构上有五个可成药位点，而MD模拟和AF2预测的apo结构则识别出较少位点。
